details: The tension slider correctly uses cancelAnimationFrame+RAF coalescing to prevent update storms, and hover events use `pointerenter`/`pointerleave` (unified pointer events, no mouse-touch double-fire) with an `activeLeaf === leafId` guard to skip redundant redraws. No D3 transitions are used (WebGL direct draw only), eliminating handoff race conditions, and there is no cross-view dispatch system that could cause feedback loops.
